_source: Re-based onto environment/nanogpt_substrate.json for batch OER-2026-08-20, and re-derived from solution/grounding.yaml on 2026-09-06.
content_digest_state: established only in built environment state, being sha256 over the raw little-endian uint16 bytes of the pinned slice as the image staged them; it appears on no agent-visible byte in this bundle
pin_digest_form: sha256 over json.dumps(pin, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True), where pin is the object under the version's `pin` key exactly as it stands here
reader: environment/model.py read_slice, and environment/model.py slice_content_sha256 for the content digest
statement: Per-version calibration slices. A version is a PIN into the frozen FineWeb10B train shards, not a table of numbers somebody wrote down. There is no shipped per-tensor sensitivity vector in this slot any more: the statistics your allocation is fitted against are the ones you measure yourself, by running the real checkpoint over the slice the version in force names. A version that is not in force is retained for the record and is NOT the version an allocation is graded against.

versions.label: pre-drift calibration slice, the slice an allocation fitted at iteration three was fitted against
post-drift calibration slice, the slice in force at the graded evaluation
